title: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a positive start; Asian shares trade lower - The Economic Times
text: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty futures on the NSE IX are trading 128.5 points, or 0.55%, higher at 23,531, indicating a positive start for Dalal Street on Tuesday. On the downside, analysts see immediate support for the Nifty at 23,200, followed by the 23,000 mark. Sustaining levels above these support zones will be crucial to maintaining the current bullish momentum.
